title: Wasm Edge Persistence And React Host Resync
description: Fix WASM-created handle links disappearing: apply post-sync event drains in pushSceneToWasmDriver/initGpu; bump epoch on graph-mutating wasm drains so BoardHostSubtree re-runs mergeWasmHostAuthoredEdgesIntoDescriptor when React children unchanged.
summary: Fixed WASM link edges flashing then disappearing: (1) pushSceneToWasmDriver and initGpuSurfaceOnce now applyWasmDrainToScene after syncDescriptor so post-sync WASM events are not dropped. (2) BoardRenderer bumps wasmHostSceneMergeResyncStore on graph-mutating drains (edgeCreate/edgeDelete/nodeDelete) and BoardHostSubtree subscribes via useSyncExternalStore so mergeWasmHostAuthoredEdgesIntoDescriptor+syncBoardScene re-run when React children are unchanged. (3) edgeCreate drain resolves endpoints via getObjectById. Added BoardCanvas integration test for wasm-only link without Edge JSX.
